prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Take a quick 15-second interactive tour of your pet's desktop controls before finishing.", "Start Tour", "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to interact with and control your pet on your desktop.", "Right-click pet to open action menu", "Double-click desktop icon to hide or wake up pet", "Finish Setup"]
1: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Select whether to adopt an existing friendly pet or create a custom pet from your own photos.", "Adopt Pre-made Pet", "Create Custom Pet"]
2: ["Your Pet is Arriving Soon", "Generation is underway in the background. Enjoy a quick mini-game while we prepare your desktop friend!", "Play While Your Pet Is Being Built", "Catch falling treats to earn starter bonus snacks for your new pet!", "Skip Game"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to complete adoption and preserve your pet across desktop sessions."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Canvas", "Checking graphics drivers, system tray permissions, and desktop overlay settings...", "System compatibility check complete"]
5: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit, single-subject front-facing photos for best 3D desktop pet rendering.", "Tip: Avoid blurry images, group photos, or dark lighting."]
6: ["Sign In to Access Your Saved Pets", "Make sure to sign in with the same account (Email or Google) you used previously to automatically restore your pet.", "Syncs your pet instantly across devices"]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Compare pre-made quick adoption vs photo-customized pet creation side by side."]
8: ["Welcome Home! Claim 100 Free Pet Treats", "Finish setting up your pet on your desktop right now to receive your welcome food pack!", "Claim Treats & Start", "+100 Starter Treats Unlocked"]
9: ["Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet's name, personality, and appearance before bringing them to your desktop screen.", "Confirm & Bring Home"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions starter bonus snacks / free extras
Mentions free treats/extras and creates urgency to finish setup right now
